# Spellcasting Focus

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Spells and Magic](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#SpellcastingFocus)*

A Spellcasting Focus is an object that certain creatures can use in place of a spell's Material components if those materials aren't consumed by the spell and don't have a cost specified. Some classes allow its members to use certain types of Spellcasting Focuses. *See also* "Spells" ("[Casting Spells](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/spells#CastingSpells)").
